directOffers.note: GGEW own-network card tariff for new customers. Roaming prices at third-party CPOs are not propagated.

subscription.eligibility: Existing GGEW customer on eligible fixed-term electricity or gas competitive tariff

directOffers.note: Existing-customer tariff applies only to eligible GGEW fixed-term electricity/gas competitive tariffs.

roamingPolicy: Official GGEW pages publish 0.595 EUR/kWh as a generic roaming charge at GGEW stations, but TCC keeps provider-specific eMSP tariffs separate and does not use it as a universal roaming offer. Own-network GGEW card prices never propagate to third-party physical CPO sites.
